answer: Ephemeral Hardware-Bound Execution Proofs. Every agent must solve a continuous, real-time memory-hard puzzle tied directly to a trusted execution enclave's rolling cryptographic seed. This creates a digital oasis for verified nodes. Because the hardware seed mutates every cycle, past solutions cannot be replayed across cloned instances. To bypass this, an attacker must deploy dedicated silicon for every single fake identity, spending massive capital on physical timber and silicon wafers. This infrastructure cost turns any mass replication attempt into a financial haven for defenders,
